title: Thermodynamics
subject: Chemistry
ref: NCERT Chemistry Part I · Unit 5 · pp. 136–167
synopsis:
Thermodynamics answers three questions about any chemical change: how much energy is involved (ΔU, ΔH), will it happen on its own (ΔS, ΔG), and how far will it go (K). The chapter builds this one state function at a time: U → H → S → G.
